Container.Name: kinopeer
Container.Overview: A qBittorrent web UI for movies and TV series. Find a movie or a series, pick a release found by Prowlarr and follow the download, all in one app on your phone or computer. Install it next to your qBittorrent (4.6.0 or later) and Prowlarr containers: on its first start, Kinopeer asks for their addresses, and its Find button looks for them on Unraid's Docker network.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port you open Kinopeer at.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Kinopeer's password, the addresses and logins you enter in the app and its settings.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional, 8 characters or more. Left empty, the first visitor sets Kinopeer's password: open Kinopeer right after installing and set it.

Config.Name: qBittorrent address
Config.Description: Optional. Left empty, Kinopeer asks for it on its first start, and its Find button looks for qBittorrent. Set here, for example http://192.168.1.10:8080, it can't be changed from the app.

Config.Name: Prowlarr address
Config.Description: Optional. Left empty, Kinopeer asks for it and Prowlarr's API key after qBittorrent's. Set here, for example http://192.168.1.10:9696, it can't be changed from the app, and Kinopeer can read the key from Prowlarr's config folder (the two fields below).

Config.Name: Prowlarr config folder
Config.Description: Optional, read only with the Prowlarr address above: Prowlarr's /config folder, usually /mnt/user/appdata/prowlarr, mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Prowlarr config file
Config.Description: Optional, with the two fields above: /prowlarr/config.xml, where Kinopeer reads Prowlarr's API key.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Optional. Kinopeer answers at your server's IP address and .local name; add any other name you open it at, such as a reverse proxy's domain, comma-separated.
